_comment: JSON has no comments, so notes live here (keys outside Values do not become env vars). Copy to local.settings.json and fill in; that file is git-ignored, never commit it. FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME and AzureWebJobsStorage are required by the Functions host; dev storage is fine locally (a 'storage unhealthy' log line is harmless for the HTTP API). LLM_PROVIDER: deepseek | openai | azure | openai-compatible; see docs/tutorials/quickstart.md for each provider's keys and defaults. Cosmos DB and IoT Hub are optional: the IoT trigger registers only if IotHubEventHubConnectionString is set, and device twins are stored only if COSMOS_ENDPOINT and COSMOS_KEY are set.
